text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Mohammed inaugurates new telecoms headquarters and specialised phone services worth $8.5 million.
- Communication Minister Driss Alaoui M'daghri says rural regions and agriculture were main focus of cabinet meeting.
- United Nations secretary-general Kofi Annan meets Moroccan representative in U.N. over Western Sahara issue.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali in Spanish Sevilla to attend first session of joint commission to promote understanding and communication.
- Fisheries ministry signs convention with fisheries National Office and National Confederation of Coastal Fisheries to upgrade sector and set up specific insurance coverage for seamen.

- Trade Minister Driss Jettou says Morocco and Romania study possibility of setting up phosphates joint ventures. He said Romania's processing plants and Morocco's production could combine to market by-products.
- Stock Exchange says in statement electronic trading, which will be introduced gradually, will ensure transparency and equality between investors.
- As result of liberalisation of wheat imports, Morocco has an excess 700,000 tonnes of locally-produced wheat to sell. Agriculture Minister Hassan Abou Ayoub says it will be cleared by June.
